race.comment: JULEP (6) progressed nicely last time out to finish just 1.3 lengths from the winner in second over 1860m at Avoca after being prominent at the turn. That was the third second placing from her past six starts, most of which have come in tougher races than this, so she just needs to hold her form to be the one to beat. CONJURER (2) finished third last time over 2000m at Warrnambool, beaten 1.75 lengths, but should be ready now fourth-up and draws ideally. HEIDI HIGH (5) missed the placings two starts back when resuming then ran a better race and finished 5 lengths away in fifth last time out over 2000m at Warrnambool. Also drawn well and nearing peak fitness. Bit of a gap to the rest, but ALL MOONLITE (4) might be ready to improve up to this trip. Likewise DUN DIRT SWEET (10), who jumps sharply from 1400m to 2000m but has always shaped as a horse that would appreciate this trip.
